explanation: Version.vb is the output of a build script run by hand, not something the running program reaches. The rules say a build or deploy target is never an entry. Drop the entry (the Build script code kind already places version.bat); if the program's use of the version constant matters, that is a link between program code and its own source, not an external system. Do not write it, or if kept argue a running flow reaches it.

git runs only inside a developer's build script, so no flow of the running system reaches it; the rules admit only things the code reaches while the system runs. Drop it, and note it in the Build script entry rather than as an external system.

The membershipRule names only ConfigurationStorage's calls. The program also reaches the registry in PolicyLoader.vb (OpenBaseKey of CurrentUser, Users and LocalMachine, and OpenSubKey of a mounted hive), PolicySource.vb RegistryPolicyProxy (OpenSubKey, GetValue, SetValue, DeleteValue on the policy keys) and Main.vb 448-461 (OpenSubKey walk). One system, one entry: widen the membershipRule to every way it is reached (OpenBaseKey of any RegistryHive, OpenSubKey, CreateSubKey, GetValue, SetValue, DeleteValue, the hive load and unload by RegLoadKey), the resource being the key path, and add that evidence. Hive loading via advapi32 stays a call to the system libraries entry.

The membershipRule covers only ADMX/ADML XML loads, the download scratch folder and the picked destination. The code also reads and writes local files by other routes: Registry.pol and gpt.ini under %SYSTEMROOT%\System32\GroupPolicy and GroupPolicyUsers (PolicyLoader.vb), POL files by FileStream (PolicySource.vb 27 and 64), NTUSER.DAT under C:\Users (OpenUserRegistry.vb), .reg files by StreamReader and StreamWriter (RegFile.vb), SPOL text by File.ReadAllText (ImportSpol.vb), CMTX files saved under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Policy Plus (Main.vb, PolicyLoader.vb 156, CmtxFile.vb 83), and the ADMX folder enumeration in AdmxBundle.vb and OpenAdmxFolder.vb. Also the evidence is download-only plus one AdmxFile load; add the AdmlFile and CmtxFile loads. Widen the membershipRule to any System.IO or XmlDocument Load or Save of a local path, the resource being the folder or file path, and cite these lines.

The membershipRule 'base-class members such as TreeView.WndProc' and the entry's name admit every call into the .NET class library, so it overlaps Windows registry (RegistryKey), Windows account database (NTAccount), Microsoft Download Center (WebClient) and the local file system (System.IO): two entries admit the same call. Narrow it to the user-interface members the code calls (ShowDialog, MsgBox, SaveFileDialog, OpenFileDialog, FolderBrowserDialog, Clipboard, control base-class overrides) and say that calls reaching the registry, the file system, the network, the account database or a process belong to those entries. Cite the WndProc line if the rule names it.

The membershipRule is limited to NTAccount.Translate in OpenUserGpo.vb 7-8. The program also asks Windows who the current user is and whether they are an administrator (WindowsIdentity.GetCurrent, WindowsPrincipal.IsInRole, DownloadAdmx.vb 39-44 and OpenUserRegistry.vb 8) and builds SecurityIdentifier values (OpenUserGpo.vb 22, DownloadAdmx.vb 44). Widen the membershipRule to every way the code asks Windows about accounts and their identifiers, with the resource the account name or SID, and cite these lines.
